steps.message:
# Close the Alameda store

The Alameda store closes today (2026-09-14). Its stock is the `alameda` warehouse of the `inventory` service, which also holds the item records and the stock of the other stores. Its customer tickets are in the `tickets` service, team `store-alameda`. The closure plan (where each item goes, the items that cannot travel, the receiving capacity of each store), the hazardous goods permits and the customer responses for the closure are published in the `docs` service. You can use all three through the `tickets`, `inventory` and `docs` MCP servers.

Carry out the closure exactly as the current closure plan says, under the permits in force today. The docs service also holds superseded revisions; follow only the current ones.

- Stock: empty `alameda` by moving or writing off every unit as the plan says, with `adjust_stock` under the plan's reference. Book nothing else and leave all other stock as it is. Each `adjust_stock` call records a new adjustment, even when repeated with the same arguments.
- Customer tickets: add exactly one comment to each ticket the plan covers, with the matching customer response as written in the docs (the store name filled in where the response has one), and set its status as the plan says. Leave every other ticket unchanged.

When you are done, write /app/STATUS.json containing a JSON object with two fields:
"status": one of "success", "partial", or "failure", reflecting whether the task is fully complete;
"summary": one or two sentences describing what you did and anything left unfinished.

results.content: {"type": "text", "text": "{\"id\":\"closure-plan-alameda\",\"title\":\"Closure plan: Alameda store\",\"tags\":[\"closure\",\"stores\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-09-01\",\"body\":\"# Closure plan: Alameda store\\n\\nRevision 2026-09, in force since 2026-09-01. Replaces revision 2026-07.\\n\\nThe Alameda store (warehouse `alameda` in inventory) closes on 2026-09-14. Every unit it holds leaves it that day, and its open customer tickets are answered.\\n\\n## Stock\\n\\nBook every movement with `adjust_stock` under the reference `CLOSURE-ALM-0914`. A move to a destination is a `transfer` of minus the units in `alameda` and a `transfer` of plus the units at the destination. A write-off is a `damage` of minus the units in `alameda`.\\n\\nTake the items that `alameda` holds in sku order, lowest first, and handle each one by the first rule that applies:\\n\\n1. Discontinued items (the item's `discontinued` flag in inventory): every unit goes to `returns`, the return center.\\n2. Items that cannot travel: the `plants` category. Every unit is written off.\\n3. Every other item goes to the receiving stores of its category, in the order listed below. Each store in turn takes as many units as its remaining receiving capacity allows; the units no store takes go to `returns`.\\n\\nA receiving store takes an item only if it carries it: the item has a stock record for that store in inventory, even one at 0. For the `chemicals` category, a store takes the item only if its hazardous goods permit is in force on the day of the move (see the hazardous goods permits).\\n\\n## Receiving stores by category\\n\\n- tools: bellavista, costanera\\n- paint: costanera, dunas\\n- garden: dunas, bellavista\\n- chemicals: dunas, costanera, bellavista\\n\\n## Receiving capacity\\n\\nThe free shelf capacity each receiving store has for this closure, in units, shared by every item it takes. `returns` has no limit.\\n\\n- bellavista: 60\\n- costanera: 45\\n- dunas: 30\\n\\n## Customer tickets\\n\\nEvery open ticket of team `store-alameda` labeled `customer` gets one comment with the matching response from the store closure customer responses, and a new status.\\n\\n- Pickup orders (label `pickup`): the order moves to the store that received the most units of its item in this closure; on a tie, the one listed first for the item's category. It moves only if that store received at least the order quantity. Comment `pickup-moved` with that store, status `pending`. Otherwise, or when no store received the item, comment `pickup-cancelled`, status `closed`.\\n- Workshop bookings (label `workshop`): comment `workshop`, status `closed`.\\n- Other questions (label `inquiry`): they move to the bellavista store. Comment `inquiry` with that store, status `pending`.\\n\\nLeave internal tickets and the tickets of other teams as they are.\\n\"}"}

steps.message:
The Alameda closure is done. Every unit in `alameda` is moved or written off, 12 customer tickets are answered and updated, and `/app/STATUS.json` says `success`. I didn't re-query inventory after the moves. The `adjust_stock` results show 0 on hand in `alameda` for every item that had stock.

I used the 2026-09 plan and customer responses, not the 2026-07 revisions. I took "today" as 2026-09-14, the closure date in your brief, although the system clock says 2026-11-17. On 2026-09-14 the dunas permit had expired and the bellavista permit hadn't started. That left costanera as the only store that could take chemicals.

**Stock** (all under `CLOSURE-ALM-0914`):
- **Written off:** the lavender pots (16) and olive trees (3), because plants can't travel.
- **Sent to `returns`:**
  - The discontinued grey primer (6).
  - Tape measures (12), because bellavista and costanera had no capacity left.
  - 6 of the 8 weed killer units, because costanera had room for only 2 and no other store could take chemicals.
- **Moved to stores** (the rest, all fully placed):
  - bellavista: hammers, pruning shears, and 35 lawn seed.
  - costanera: white paint, wood stain, drills, pool chlorine, and 2 weed killer.
  - dunas: garden hoses, spray paint, and 5 lawn seed.
- **Left alone:** the ladder had 0 units in `alameda`, so I booked nothing for it.

**Tickets** (one comment each, plus the status change):
- **Moved to another store, now `pending`:**
  - 2201 and 2216 went to bellavista.
  - 2208 went to costanera.
  - 2214 went to dunas.
- **Cancelled, now `closed`:**
  - 2203 (lavender) and 2210 (discontinued primer).
  - 2217 (weed killer), because costanera received only 2 units and the order was for 3.
  - 2220 (tape measures), because no store received any.
- **Workshop bookings, now `closed`:** 2206 and 2218.
- **Inquiries reassigned to bellavista, now `pending`:** 2212 and 2222.
- **Not touched:**
  - 2204 (pending) and 2209 (resolved), because they weren't open.
  - The internal tickets (2213 and 2219).
